dct_description_sm: # Afghanistan Earthquakes: Damage Proxy Maps, Sep 2025 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Afghanistan Earthquakes (Sep 2025) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Kunar Province, Afghanistan, Earthquakes, 1 Sep 2025, v0.7-full ** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Kunar Province, Afghanistan, Earthquakes, 1 Sep 2025, v0.7-bldg ** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:**
